Notes

The data on 8 (Not Reportable) collected in 1976 are no longer contained in the data file. The data for that year are not consistent with the documentation of the time. The data element name was “Extent of Deformation” from 1975 to 2008. The data element’s name was changed to “Extent of Damage” in 2009. Prior to 2016 the Data Element ID was V29. From 2016 to 2019 the Data Element ID was V30. This data element also appears in the Parkwork Data File as PVEH_SEV.

Releases
